tournaments.title: VALORANT Champions Tour 2026: Berlin
tournaments.subtitle: The pinnacle of global VALORANT competitive play.
tournaments.rulebook: Official rules: 5v5 team format, double elimination bracket. Single-agent lock per team. Standard official competitive maps only. Teams must check in 30 minutes prior to scheduled match time.

tournaments.title: IEM Katowice 2026: CS2 Major
tournaments.subtitle: The official world championship tournament for Counter-Strike 2.
tournaments.rulebook: Official rules: 5v5 MR12 competitive rule set. Double elimination playoffs. Anti-cheat client mandatory. Overtime MR3 with $10,000 start cash.

tournaments.title: ALGS Year 5 Championship
tournaments.subtitle: The world apex showdown for the finest trios on the planet.
tournaments.rulebook: Official rules: Match point format. First team to reach 50 points and subsequently win a match is crowned World Champion.

reviews.comment: VALORANT's gunplay and agent abilities hit the absolute sweet spot for tactical FPS lovers. The 128-tick servers are crisp!
Counter-Strike 2 has completely transformed the dynamic smokes and graphics. Best competitive FPS on the market.
Phantom Liberty expansion makes Cyberpunk 2077 one of the greatest sci-fi RPGs of all time. Night City is unbelievable.
Masterpiece. Elden Ring's world design, bosses, and lore are unmatched. Shadow of the Erdtree takes it to another level.
